title: 10 Torr Distilling and Brewing

services.name: Our Taproom
services.desc: Our Summer Cocktail Menu has officially landed. From playful pours like Rhubarbara Gone Wild and It’s Britney, Spritz! to bold favorites like May Day and Sazorrac, this lineup was made for long days and even longer nights. Not drinking? We’ve got you covered with a full Zero Proof menu featuring refreshing, alcohol-free cocktails like Lavvy Lemme Tell You and Fuego Lover-so everyone can sip something special. Feeling adventurous? Ask about our Scoots (Lil’ Shots) and keep the summer vibes going. 10 Torr Distilling & Brewing didn’t start with a blueprint; it started with a bold idea. blurb: 10 Torr Distilling & Brewing produces vacuum-distilled spirits and craft beers. They offer a taproom experience with a variety of drinks including canned cocktails and whiskeys. The business partners with local retailers, bars, and restaurants to distribute their products.
